operator_io_quirks: Mixed-case identifiers everywhere: "Candidate_ID", "People_ID", "Poll_Source", "Date", "Support_rate" — must be double-quoted; column lookup case-insensitive.
Column named "Date" (reserved-ish word) declared TEXT; also "Name", "Sex" — quoting required in generated SQL.

Date columns are TEXT storing non-ISO formats: candidate.Date = 'Feb 12–15, 2007' (en-dash U+2013, month-name + day-range + year); people.Date_of_Birth = '06.10.1976' (DD.MM.YYYY dots). Neither parses under TS's 7 date templates.
Declared TEXT dispatches to String fuzzer, not Date — so TS will never produce date-shaped values for these columns.
Tiny tables: candidate=6 rows, people=9 rows; original_values lists are short (<=9), so rng.choices(k=min(5,len)) draws heavily from a handful of values.
FK candidate.People_ID -> people.People_ID, parent exists and is unique PK; parent has 9 rows, child 6 — FK fill draws with replacement from 9 parent values.
All columns notnull=0, no CHECK, no UNIQUE beyond PKs — inserts rarely fail; rows_failed likely ~0.
Rates (Support/Consider/Oppose/Unsure) are REAL in [0,1] but declared REAL -> Number fuzzer with scale from 'real' (no args) => full range ~[-10^scale,10^scale]; storage real.
People_ID in candidate samples {1,3,4,6,7} — not all parent ids used; some parent rows unreferenced.
No composite keys, no self-FK, no dangling FK, no views/triggers/indexes beyond PKs.
Non-ASCII in samples: 'Stéphane Antiga', en-dash in Date — String fuzzer CHARSET is ASCII-only, so fresh strings lose accents.
Table order: people (level 0) before candidate (level 1) — FK fill sees final people values.
operator_ts_expectations: candidate.Date / people.Date_of_Birth: String fuzzer (declared TEXT) -> random a-zA-Z0-9() strings + contaminate, NOT dates; any gold query filtering on date format/range will mismatch -> likely FN/FP.
Poll_Source, Name, Sex: String fuzzer -> random strings; Sex 'M'/'F' becomes arbitrary strings, so 'Sex = M' style predicates lose selectivity -> FP risk.

People_ID / Candidate_ID: Number fuzzer, int, no args => scale default, full range ~[-10^scale,10^scale] with +-1/+-2 perturbation; PK dedup keeps 6/9 distinct but values implausible (huge ints) -> joins still work but range predicates on IDs implausible.
Rates: Number fuzzer real, full range wide (not [0,1]); SUM/AVG/rate comparisons implausible -> FN on threshold predicates, FP on ordering.

FK fill: candidate.People_ID drawn from people.People_ID final values with replacement -> referential integrity holds, but ties/duplicates in child FK (6 rows over 9 parents) create duplicate People_ID in candidate -> joins produce multiplicity gold may not expect.
Small sizes: choose_table_sizes may give 1-30 rows; with 6/9 originals, distinct counts collapse -> COUNT/DISTINCT queries fragile.
String contaminate (0.5) adds suffix/prefix/drop-char -> 'M'/'F' and Poll_Source names become noisy, breaking equality predicates.
Date fuzzer never engaged (no date/timestamp declared type) — TS's date machinery unused here.
p=0.2 fresh-draw probability and max_l0 cap mean many values are reused originals -> some gold predicates accidentally match (FP) when original value reappears.
No NOT NULL/CHECK enforcement: NULLs can appear where original had none (Number/String drop None but fresh draws never NULL; FK empty parent -> NULL only if parent empty, unlikely here).
